issues.where: the two cotyledons, f0273 (9.1 s) and f0305 (10.2 s)
issues.what: the seed leaves don't wilt, droop or yellow. They go see-through and ghostly while keeping their shape, so they fade out like a dissolve and don't age like real leaves
issues.fix: keep them opaque and animate a real senescence: droop, curl, yellow and brown, then drop or flatten against the soil

issues.what: in the stretch where growth should be fastest, the leaf shapes and angles are the same in all 12 frames. In set-D-03 the plant only slides sideways as one rigid block with the pan. Heavy rain is falling, but no leaf flutters, dips under a drop or moves on its own, so the plant reads as frozen
issues.fix: add a small per-leaf secondary motion (sway and little dips when drops hit, each with its own phase) and keep growth going frame to frame so the plant is never perfectly still

issues.where: ground left of the stem, f0305 → f0338 (10.2–11.3 s), and f0436 → f0468 (14.5–15.6 s)
issues.what: the small round puddle becomes a long winding stream with new soil banks in about 1 s. The seed husk and the small sprout left of the stem disappear. Later the bare soil turns into a grass field. The terrain looks like it was swapped or morphed, not worn down over time
issues.fix: carve the rivulet slowly from the existing puddle over several seconds, keep the husk and sprout until they are washed away or buried, and grow the grass in from tiny sprouts

issues.where: leaf surfaces and stem across f0421–f0432
issues.what: rain streaks pass in front of the leaves, but none of them land. There are no splashes, beads that grow or run, or wet ripples on the leaf, so the rain reads as an overlay layer
issues.fix: add impact splashes and droplets running along the leaf surfaces and the stem, matched to where streaks end

issues.where: foreground rain streaks, upper right of f0421 and f0422
issues.what: a few streaks are much brighter and thicker than the rest and show up for only one frame, which reads as a flickering streak, not a drop falling through depth
issues.fix: keep streak brightness and size tied to depth and motion blur so near drops stay consistent across frames

issues.where: apical bud and the grass clump to the right, f0239 → f0240
issues.what: the cut is clean in one frame and the plant, husk, grass and horizon line up. The bud changes from a closed amber tip to a greener, slightly fuller one, and the right grass blades change shape a little, so the plant changes slightly along with the world
issues.fix: lock the plant and grass geometry across the cut and change only the lighting and weather
